title: Ludo: Move the Token
story: In a board game a token moves by the dice roll, but you must land exactly on the finish square.
goal: Write move(pos, roll, finish=30): return pos + roll, unless that would go past finish, then the token stays where it is.
hints: Work out the new square first. Then decide whether it is allowed.
If pos + roll is more than finish, return the old pos.
socratic: Is landing exactly on finish allowed?
What does the default value finish=30 do?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Ludo: Move the Token”?
alt:
def move(pos, roll, finish=30):
    return pos if pos + roll > finish else pos + roll
